tagline: Slim 50mm track spot with the driver hidden in the track adaptor.
description: Compact die-cast aluminium track spotlight with a CoB LED source and interchangeable PC lens optics. The driver is fully concealed in the track adaptor, keeping the head to just 50mm diameter.
specification: PC lens optics 15° | 24° | 36° | 50°. In-track driver (housed in the track adaptor). CoB LED. MacAdam 3. L90/B10 >50,000h. Eye safety RG0/RG1. UGR<19. Die-cast aluminium, epoxy powder coat (wrinkled finish). Standard 230–240V 50–60Hz, PF>0.97; DALI (suffix D) and Bluetooth (suffix BT) versions. Colour suffix W = White RAL 9003, BK = Black RAL 9005; other colours on request. 2700K (K27) and 5000K (K5) on request. CE, ETL. Energy class E. 5-year warranty.
dimensions_note: Head Ø50mm; driver housed in the track adaptor. See catalogue extract for full dimensions.
